scenario: Interpolation TIME_SPEC `:%Y-%m-%d` on a Time slot — `{e.ts:%Y-%m-%d}` resolves at compile time to a TimePrim of three fields (YEAR, MONTH, DAY) and two literal `-` items (`dsc.rete.rlow_6_4_resolve` from `dsc.strlit.lgra_2_9_6_1_format`); no pattern reaches the artefact (LGRA.2.9.6.4). The slot is a Time because a timestamp spec on anything else is refused. compile_ok pins acceptance only; the items are pinned by `test_encode`'s round trip through the runtime decoder.
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    id: Int key
    ts: Time

rule r:
    Event e
->
    log info "at {e.ts:%Y-%m-%d}"
